texts.preamble: Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2020 Bench: Ramesh Sinha, Raj Beer Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 1 Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7352 of 2020 Petitioner :- Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And Another Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashutosh Kumar Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A. Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J. Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J. This petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer to quash the F.I.R. dated 29.06.2020 registered as case crime no. 459 of 2020 under section 3(1) of U.P. Gangster & Anti-social Activities Act, 1986, police station Mohamdabad, District Mau.
texts.facts: This petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer to quash the F.I.R. dated 29.06.2020 registered as case crime no. 459 of 2020 under section 3(1) of U.P. Gangster & Anti-social Activities Act, 1986, police station Mohamdabad, District Mau.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the gang chart only one case has been shown against the petitioners i.e., Case Crime No. 440 of 2020, under Sections 188, 269 IPC, Section 3 Epidemic Act, Section 5/8 of Environment (Protection) Act and Section 31(1)/63 Food Safety and Standards Act in which petitioners have already been enlarged on bail. He further submits that the Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191673724/ 1 impugned F.I.R. under the Gangster Act, has been lodged against the petitioners, when in fact, they are neither the member of any gang nor they run any gang involved in anti-social activities. The allegation levelled against the petitioners is absolutely false, frivolous and baseless.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the gang chart only one case has been shown against the petitioners i.e., Case Crime No. 440 of 2020, under Sections 188, 269 IPC, Section 3 Epidemic Act, Section 5/8 of Environment (Protection) Act and Section 31(1)/63 Food Safety and Standards Act in which petitioners have already been enlarged on bail. He further submits that the Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191673724/ 1 impugned F.I.R. under the Gangster Act, has been lodged against the petitioners, when in fact, they are neither the member of any gang nor they run any gang involved in anti-social activities.
texts.respondent_arguments: The allegation levelled against the petitioners is absolutely false, frivolous and baseless.
